summary: Sibanye Stillwater Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a precious metals mining company in South Africa, the United States, Europe, and Australia. The company produces platinum group metals (PGMs), platinum, palladium, rhodium, ruthenium, iridium, gold, lithium, zinc, nickel, copper, and silver. Sibanye Stillwater Limited was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Weltevredenpark, South Africa.
ceo: Dr. Richard Andrew Stewart B.Sc., BSc (Hons), M.B.A., Ph.D., Pr.Sci.Nat.
